## What changed and why

A sentence or two about the change, plus the issue number if there is one.

## Type of change (delete what doesn't apply)

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / performance work

## Before you hit submit

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` has been run
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features` comes back clean
- [ ] `cargo check` passes and the app actually runs
- [ ] No Tailwind or CSS framework additions in the UI
- [ ] No `.git` modifications or git commands issued from application code
